Recorded claim:
`commands/try.mjs` emits `--no-artifact` when `artifact` is `false`, otherwise `--artifact`. `tb.mjs` shares try option definitions with submit, so copy the artifact option for submit with `defaultValue: "false"`; do not mutate `commands.try.options`. [Task 1]
